    <script type="text/javascript">
        function validateMobileNumber() {
            var mobileNumber = document.getElementById('ContentPlaceHolder1_txtmobile').value;
            var mobileNumber = document.getElementById('ContentPlaceHolder1_txtmobile1').value;
            var mobileNumber = document.getElementById('ContentPlaceHolder1_txtmobileno').value;

            var pattern = /^[6-9][0-9]{9}$/;

            if (pattern.test(mobileNumber)) {
                return true;
            } else {
                alert("Please enter a valid mobile number!");
                return false;
            }
        }
    </script>

            var ddllang = document.getElementById('ContentPlaceHolder1_ddllang');

                txtcaptcha1.value = '';

                ddllang.selectedIndex = 1;
            }
        }

            var txtMojaniKr = document.getElementById('ContentPlaceHolder1_txtMojaniKr');

            var txtcaptchakprat = document.getElementById('ContentPlaceHolder1_txtcaptchakprat');

                ddlkpratlang.selectedIndex = 1;

    <script>
        function restrictToNumeric(event) {
            var charCode = event.which ? event.which : event.keyCode;
            if (charCode > 31 && (charCode < 48 || charCode > 57)) {
                event.preventDefault();
            }


        }
        function restrictToChar(event) {
            var charCode = event.which ? event.which : event.keyCode;
            if ((charCode >= 65 && charCode <= 90) || (charCode >= 97 && charCode <= 122) || (charCode === 46) || (charCode === 32)) {

                return charCode;
            }
            else {
                event.preventDefault();
            }
        }

    </script>

    <script type="text/javascript">
        function preventSave(event) {
            if (event.ctrlKey && (event.key === 's' || event.key === 'S')) {
                event.preventDefault();
            }
        }
        document.addEventListener('keydown', preventSave);
    </script>

    <script type="text/javascript">
        function preventSave(event) {
            if (event.altKey && (event.key === 'f' || event.key === 'F')) {
                event.preventDefault();
            }
        }
        document.addEventListener('keydown', preventSave);
    </script>

    <script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            // Disable Google Chrome's auto-translate prompt
            const meta = document.createElement('meta');
            meta.setAttribute('name', 'google');
            meta.setAttribute('content', 'notranslate');
            document.head.appendChild(meta);
        });
    </script>

    <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
        const el = document.getElementById("ContentPlaceHolder1_lbldist");
        if (!el) return;

        // Get the original Marathi text from attribute
        const originalText = (el.getAttribute("data-original") || "").trim();
        if (!originalText) return;

        let alertShown = false;

        // Function to handle detected translation change
        function handleChange() {
            if (alertShown) return;
            alertShown = true;
            alert("सूचना -: भूलेख संकेतस्थळ फक्त मराठीत उपलब्ध असून English साठी Google Transliteration चा वापर अपेक्षित नाही.");
            // After user clicks OK -> reload the page
            location.reload();
        }

        // Observe for text changes (Google Translate modifies text)
        const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
            const currentText = el.innerText.trim();
            if (currentText !== originalText) {
                handleChange();
                observer.disconnect();
            }
        });

        observer.observe(el, { childList: true, characterData: true, subtree: true });

        // Fallback interval (if MutationObserver fails)
        setInterval(() => {
            const currentText = el.innerText.trim();
            if (currentText !== originalText && !alertShown) {
                handleChange();
            }
        }, 1500);
    });
</script>

  <!-- Menu Toggle Script -->
  <script>
      $("#menu-toggle").click(function (e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          $("#wrapper").toggleClass("toggled");
      });
  </script>



<script>
    // number count for stats, using jQuery animate

    $('.counting').each(function () {
        var $this = $(this),
            countTo = $this.attr('data-count');

        $({ countNum: $this.text() }).animate({
            countNum: countTo
        },

            {

                duration: 3000,
                easing: 'linear',
                step: function () {
                    $this.text(Math.floor(this.countNum));
                },
                complete: function () {
                    $this.text(this.countNum);
                    //alert('finished');
                }

            });

    });
</script>
 
  <script type="text/javascript">  
      $('.Count').each(function () {
          $(this).prop('Counter', 0).animate({
              Counter: $(this).text()
          }, {
              duration: 2000,
              easing: 'swing',
              step: function (now) {
                  $(this).text(Math.ceil(now));
              }
          });
      });
  </script>  


  <script>
      $(document).ready(function () {
          $(".b-navdropdown-click").click(function () {
              if ($(".b-navdropdown").hasClass("hide")) {
                  $(".b-navdropdown").addClass("show");
                  $(".b-navdropdown").removeClass("hide");
                  // $(".b-icon-up").show();
                  // $(".b-icon-down").hide();
              }
              else if ($(".b-navdropdown").hasClass("show")) {
                  $(".b-navdropdown").addClass("hide");
                  $(".b-navdropdown").removeClass("show");
                  // $(".b-icon-down").show();
                  // $(".b-icon-up").hide();
              }
          });
      });

  </script>
